label: Arm (upper arm, forearm, hand)
comment: Local frame, units of the parent bone's own length: x is rigging._limb_frame's sideways axis (flipped for side='R'), y continues the parent bone's own head->tail direction, z is the remaining orthogonal axis. An arm mostly extends sideways (x) and back along the parent's direction (negative y, which is 'down' when the parent points up, as a chest or shoulder bone does).
